svg.aria-label: Where the product sits in the Blue Rewards system. The product is a dedicated space inside the existing Blue Rewards app, nested within the programme systems of record, which are nested within BMO. The member is to the left, evidence authorities to the right, and forces outside the boundary across the top. The product owns no system of record.
svg.text: TEAM ZIG · BLUE REWARDS · SYSTEMS MAP FIGURE FOR THE PRD
Where our proposed enhancement would sit
An enhanced experience within Blue Rewards

What this figure shows — the Blue Rewards system as it works today, and the one place inside it where Team Zig’s proposed enhancement would live. Read it from the outside in. Only the navy box is new; everything around it already exists.

g.text: Neither BMO nor this work can change these.
They set the conditions everything else runs in.
The programme sees some of what a member does,
with or without a BMO banking relationship
what the enhancement is built around
a purchase made outside a route that earns
a competing programme or cashback card
members named PC Optimum, Scene and RBC
a trip abandoned after checking the price
a plan the member has not told anyone
What the programme records is what a member did
inside it, not everything they bought or wanted.
Owns Blue Rewards, funds it and carries the cost of the points members hold.
Where the official records live. We would read from these and write back to them, not replace them.
WHAT WE ARE PROPOSING TO BUILD
A dedicated space inside the Blue Rewards app and website. Everything around it already exists.
Blue, the optional conversational assistant, works across all four and shares the same saved information
We would hold none of the official records. What we would own is whether the member understands them.
The only new records we would create
A saved goal · a saved comparison · ranked options with the reason for the ranking · a case the member can follow
Each knows a different part of what happened to a member.
We would work with all five, and control none of them.
cases routed to whoever is responsible

Underneath, value moves through the five stages on the systems map. This enhancement does not move value itself — existing Blue Rewards services and partners still do that. It changes whether the member can see, judge, follow and recover it.
Three measures we propose for these stages
Did it reach them, and did they act
value received ÷ value earned and due
Did what they earned actually arrive
The whole journey, end to end
WHAT THIS ENHANCEMENT DOES NOT REPLACE
• Existing earning methods: partner scans, linked-card offers, receipts, Shops and BMO products.
• Redemption fulfilment: gift cards, travel, merchandise and partner redemptions.
• BMO and partner support where manual investigation or partner action is required.
• Partner issuance, redemption and reversal: those services need partner credentials, not a member session.
Team Zig · Blue Rewards capstone · Figure for section 3 of the Product Requirements Document. Full interactive systems map: joannjmj48-ui.github.io/mdpm-capstone/systems-thinking-v2/
